snippet.title: Incident Archives - Flight 882 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam :- https://store.steampowered.com/app/4625290/Incident_Archives__Flight_882/

This is launch trailer of Incident Archives - Flight 882, a psychological horror game and first game in the Incident Archives series inspired by true events.
In this game you play as a First Officer on a night flight who is paired with a new Captain for the journey but what begins as a normal flight slowly turns unsettling as the situation slowly turns intense.

Price - Free.

Socials - 
Website :- https://www.astronixgames.com/
Discord :- https://discord.gg/JyqWYQkh3w
Reddit :- https://www.reddit.com/r/AstronixGames/
Instagram :- https://www.instagram.com/astronix_games/

#psychologicalhorror #horror #trailer
